muse.method: Collect production evidence on a disposable local node before each lab transaction/signature. Replay those observations through the production scan API and real Muse into a separate SQLite store. Preserve original observation times and blocks; later scans can flag stale evidence. Add five explicit backend-input profiles. No claim that 71 cases traversed MetaMask.

capabilities.scope: Fixed zero-value probes only. Historical balance at one height does not establish full archive retention; one trace does not prove complete asset coverage. Unavailable may mean unsupported, disabled, rate-limited or timed out.
